meta.name: instagram-profile-posts
meta.description: Scrapes posts from an Instagram user's profile feed including captions, media URLs, like/comment counts, timestamps and location tags. Use when user mentions scraping Instagram posts, download Instagram feed, get posts from Instagram account, IG profile posts, Instagram user posts, pull posts from Instagram, Instagram post list, get someone's Instagram content, batch download Instagram, Instagram media scraper.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 批量抓取 Instagram 用户帖子的图文内容
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从 Instagram 账号批量获取帖子数据
copy.tagline_en: Scrape posts from an Instagram user's profile feed
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to batch fetch post data from Instagram accounts

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以自动抓取指定 Instagram 用户的公开帖子，包括图片/视频链接、文字描述、点赞数、评论数、发布时间和地点。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 获取某个 Instagram 账号的帖子列表、下载其内容或抓取 IG 主页信息时触发。

say.text: 帮我下载 @natgeo 最近 20 条帖子。
say.note: Claude 会开始抓取该账号的帖子并返回数据。

say.text: 获取 @nasa 主页的帖子列表，包括点赞和评论数。
say.note: Claude 会返回帖子的详细信息。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can automatically scrape public posts from a specified Instagram user, including media URLs, captions, like/comment counts, timestamps, and location tags.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to fetch posts from an Instagram account, download their feed, or scrape IG profile information.

say_en.note: Claude will start scraping the account's posts and return the data.

say_en.text: Get the post list from @nasa's profile, including like and comment counts.
say_en.note: Claude will return detailed post information.
